# Modification notice for the TokTier pinned build

This distribution contains a modified build of gigatoken.

Upstream project: https://github.com/marcelroed/gigatoken
Upstream commit: 34a1599f0c0ae7d7cd0d1c530e6522320158b360
Upstream version: 0.10.0
Modified version: 0.10.0+toktier.pinned.1

TokTier's changes pin the Unicode property data and normalization behavior used
by the BPE implementation so the certified repair path is byte-for-byte
compatible with the Hugging Face tokenizers 0.22.2 reference for the supported
tokenizer artifacts. The changes also add checked error handling to the
SentencePiece loading boundary.

The build uses ICU4X icu_properties 2.2 with baked data generated by
icu4x-datagen 2.2.0 from Unicode Character Database 16.0.0 and icuexport
release-77-1. It also uses unicode-normalization-alignments 0.1.12.
